verdict.rationale: The axis applies because GST runs a developer API portal (developer.gst.gov.in) with registration and login, so a public sandbox for its machine channel is a fair question. However, none of the evidence documents a sandbox, test environment, or end-to-end testing path. The remaining items cover taxpayer help modules (registration, returns, payments) and the Offline Tool, none of which is a pre-production test rail.
